description.value: An exploratory fMRI study comparing neural responses to spicy versus non-spicy food cues in extreme spicy food cravers and non-cravers.

spans.text: This exploratory study aimed to determine neural circuits underlying spicy food craving by comparing brain response to the cues of foods containing chili peppers in extreme cravers and non-cravers

The aim of the current exploratory study was to test the hypothesis that regions previously implicated in food and drug craving would show greater responses to the cues of foods that contain chili peppers in extreme spicy food cravers versus non-cravers.
The significance level was set at p < 0.05, whole-brain corrected for family-wise error rate (FWE).
The final sample consisted of 25 extreme cravers (13 females) and 26 non-cravers (12 females) (age: M = 20.0 years, SD = 1.8; Body Mass Index (BMI: kg/m 2 ): M = 20.6, SD = 2.2).
